# Tech Product/Feature Announcement Template

- **Introduction**
    > This sprint we have implemented some new features which is [Feature Name]! This feature is designed to [specific purpose or problem it solves] and is part of our ongoing mission to make the experience with [product/service] even better.
     
- **What’s New?**
    > A summary of the feature or change.
    > Example:
    > - **[Feature 1]**: [Description of Feature 1]
    > - **[Feature 2]**: [Description of Feature 2]
    
- **Why This Matters and who will be affected:**
    > Explain the value or impact on stakeholders and what department will utilize this feature.
    
- **When It’s Live:**
    > Specify the launch date/time or whether the feature is available immediately.
